power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.label: Craftable coal ore
power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.description: Surround 1 stone with 8 coal in a crafting table to make 1 coal ore.

power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.label: Craftable iron ore
power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.description: Surround 1 stone with 8 iron ingots in a crafting table to make 1 iron ore.

power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.label: Craftable gold ore
power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.description: Surround 1 stone with 8 gold ingots in a crafting table to make 1 gold ore.

power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.label: Craftable lapis lazuli ore
power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.description: Surround 1 stone with 8 lapis lazuli in a crafting table to make 1 lapis ore.

power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.label: Craftable diamond ore
power_controls:recipes.obtainable.crafta.description: Surround 1 stone with 8 diamonds in a crafting table to make 1 diamond ore.

power_controls:tweaks.sugarCaneOnSand.label: Allow placing sugar cane on sand

power_controls:tweaks.boatsDropThemselve.label: Boats drop themselves when broken by a player

power_controls:tweaks.shearHarvesting.label: Harvest cobwebs with shears
power_controls:tweaks.shearHarvesting.description: Shears collect cobwebs; swords collect string.

power_controls:tweaks.expandChickenHitbo.label: Expand chicken hitbox
power_controls:tweaks.expandChickenHitbo.description: Expands chicken hitbox to it's modern size

power_controls:tweaks.stackableChests.label: Stackable chests
power_controls:tweaks.stackableChests.description: Allows you to stack chests on top of each other

power_controls:tweaks.modernFlintAndStee.label: Don't damage flint and steel on failed ignite

power_controls:tweaks.allowIgnitingEntit.label: Allow igniting entities with flint and steel

power_controls:userinterface.showQuitBut.label: Show quit button
power_controls:userinterface.showQuitBut.description: Shows Quit Button on the Main Menu

power_controls:userinterface.frontViewTh.label: Third-person front view
power_controls:userinterface.frontViewTh.description: Disabled switches between first person and rear view. Normal adds a front view; Hide HUD shows it while the HUD is hidden.

power_controls:userinterface.clearTextFi.label: Clear text field with right click
power_controls:userinterface.clearTextFi.description: Right clicking on a text field will clear it

power_controls:userinterface.versionText.label: Version text
power_controls:userinterface.versionText.description: Only has effect if custom version text is enabled

power_controls:userinterface.panoramaCon.label: Background
power_controls:userinterface.panoramaCon.description: Choose an original Minecraft panorama, or Original dirt background to use the classic menu background. Preview each scene before going Back.

power_controls:userinterface.photoModeCo.label: Photo mode button
power_controls:userinterface.photoModeCo.description: Enables the Photo Mode button in game menu

power_compat:config.STACK_SIZE_CONFIG.st.label: Stackable empty buckets
power_compat:config.STACK_SIZE_CONFIG.st.description: Empty buckets stack to 16. Filled buckets stay separate. Existing stacks are preserved when disabled.

power_compat:config.addBiomeToDebugOverl.label: Biome
power_compat:config.addBiomeToDebugOverl.description: Include biome in the left-side F3 information.

power_compat:config.addDayCounterToDebug.label: Day count
power_compat:config.addDayCounterToDebug.description: Include day count in the left-side F3 information.

power_compat:config.addTotalPlayTimeToDe.label: Hours played
power_compat:config.addTotalPlayTimeToDe.description: Include hours played in the left-side F3 information.

power_compat:config.addSlimeChunkToDebug.label: Slime chunk
power_compat:config.addSlimeChunkToDebug.description: Include slime chunk in the left-side F3 information.

power_compat:config.overlayAdditionsYOff.label: Additions to debug overlay y offset

power_compat:config.disableColoredSheepS.label: Disable colored sheep spawning
power_compat:config.disableColoredSheepS.description: Makes sheep always spawn with white wool

power_compat:config.allowCraftingInvento.label: Use player 2x2 crafting grid as inventory

creative.flight.label: Creative flight
creative.flight.description: Enable Creative flight. Double-tap Jump to start or stop flying. /fly changes this same preference; Survival flight uses its world permission.

creative.landStopsFlight.label: Stop flying on landing
creative.landStopsFlight.description: Return to walking when you touch the ground.

creative.sprintToggle.label: Flight sprint activation
creative.sprintToggle.description: Hold requires the shared flight sprint key. Toggle keeps sprint active until movement stops on all axes.

creative.flightSpeed.label: Flight speed
creative.flightSpeed.description: 100% matches standard modern Creative flight. Around 40% matches Beta walking horizontally; 200% doubles the 100% speed. Applies before the sprint multiplier.

creative.sprintMultiplier.label: Flight sprint speed
creative.sprintMultiplier.description: Multiplier of this mode's normal flight speed: 100% gives no boost; 200% doubles it. The flight speed setting applies first.

creative.glide.label: Flight deceleration
creative.glide.description: Coasting after releasing movement. 0 stops immediately; 5 matches modern Creative and Spectator deceleration. Lower values stop sooner without changing the configured speed. Applies horizontally and vertically.

creative.spectatorScroll.label: Scroll to change speed
creative.spectatorScroll.description: Adjust spectator flight speed with the mouse wheel.

creative.showSpectatorSpeed.label: Show spectator speed
creative.showSpectatorSpeed.description: Display the current speed while it changes.

creative.spectatorSpeed.label: Flight speed
creative.spectatorSpeed.description: 100% matches standard modern Creative flight. Around 40% matches Beta walking horizontally; 200% doubles the 100% speed. The wheel adjusts the speed during the visit.

creative.spectatorScrollStep.label: Speed step
creative.spectatorScrollStep.description: Percentage points added or removed per wheel notch, relative to the 100% modern Creative flight baseline. 10 changes 100% to 110%, rather than multiplying the current speed.

creative.blockReach.label: Block reach
creative.blockReach.description: Interaction reach in Creative. Container previews use this distance in every game mode.

creative.entityReach.label: Entity reach
creative.entityReach.description: Interaction reach in Creative. Container previews use this distance in every game mode.

creative.destroySlot.label: Destroy slot
creative.destroySlot.description: Drag items to the slot beside the hotbar to delete them.

creative.shiftClearsInventory.label: Shift-click clears inventory
creative.shiftClearsInventory.description: Shift-click the destroy slot to clear inventory and armor.

worldedit.wandItem.label: Wand item
worldedit.wandItem.description: Choose the item used as the selection wand.

worldedit.blockLimit.label: Maximum blocks per edit
worldedit.blockLimit.description: Reject edits above this limit before making changes.

worldedit.blocksPerTick.label: Blocks processed per tick
worldedit.blocksPerTick.description: Lower values keep large edits responsive.

worldedit.historySize.label: Undo history
worldedit.historySize.description: Maximum number of edit records kept in memory.

tweaks.placement.enabled.label: Fast placement
tweaks.placement.enabled.description: Hold right-click to keep placing blocks.

tweaks.placement.attemptsPerTick.label: Placement attempts per tick
tweaks.placement.attemptsPerTick.description: Maximum placement attempts per game tick.

tweaks.placement.slabMode.label: Vertical slab placement
tweaks.placement.slabMode.description: Continuous layers, double slabs, or repeat the first slab configuration.

tweaks.placement.rememberOrientation.label: Remember orientation
tweaks.placement.rememberOrientation.description: Keep the initial orientation during continuous placement.

tweaks.placement.restrictionEnabled.label: Placement restriction
tweaks.placement.restrictionEnabled.description: Constrain continued placement using the first successful placement.

tweaks.placement.restrictionTiedToFast.label: Tie restriction to fast placement
tweaks.placement.restrictionTiedToFast.description: Turning fast placement on or off also changes the restriction switch.

tweaks.placement.restrictionMode.label: Restriction rule
tweaks.placement.restrictionMode.description: Face, plane, layer, column, line or diagonal.

tweaks.placement.listMode.label: Fast placement item filter
tweaks.placement.listMode.description: Choose which held items can use fast placement. Off allows every item; Exclude blocks the excluded list; Allow only admits the allowed list. Ordinary placement is unchanged.

tweaks.placement.blacklist.label: Exclude from fast placement
tweaks.placement.blacklist.description: Items that cannot use fast placement when the filter is set to Exclude.

tweaks.placement.whitelist.label: Allow for fast placement
tweaks.placement.whitelist.description: Only these items can use fast placement when the filter is set to Allow only. An empty list permits nothing.

tweaks.hotbar.numberRowKeys.label: Modifier + number selects row
tweaks.hotbar.numberRowKeys.description: While holding the row modifier, keys 1, 2 and 3 select the top, middle and bottom inventory rows.

tweaks.hotbar.overlay.label: Row preview
tweaks.hotbar.overlay.description: Show inventory rows while holding the preview or row modifier.

tweaks.hotbar.reverseScroll.label: Reverse row scrolling
tweaks.hotbar.reverseScroll.description: Reverse which inventory row is chosen by each scroll direction.

tweaks.hotbar.rememberRow.label: Remember the selected row
tweaks.hotbar.rememberRow.description: Keep the selected inventory row between hotbar swaps.

tweaks.hotbar.selectedRow.label: Starting row
tweaks.hotbar.selectedRow.description: Inventory row selected before using a row key or scrolling. Remember row can update this selection.

tweaks.hotbar.alignment.label: Preview alignment
tweaks.hotbar.alignment.description: Anchor the inventory-row preview relative to the screen.

tweaks.hotbar.offsetX.label: Horizontal offset
tweaks.hotbar.offsetX.description: Move the row preview horizontally from its anchor, in scaled GUI pixels.

tweaks.hotbar.offsetY.label: Vertical offset
tweaks.hotbar.offsetY.description: Move the row preview vertically from its anchor, in scaled GUI pixels.

tweaks.clickMining.label: Continuous click mining
tweaks.clickMining.description: Remove the delay between breaking blocks in singleplayer.

tweaks.obsidianBreakingSpeed.label: Obsidian breaking speed
tweaks.obsidianBreakingSpeed.description: Speed up obsidian mining with a diamond pickaxe in singleplayer. 0 is off and keeps vanilla speed. 100 matches a modern Efficiency V netherite pickaxe with Haste II: 1.55 seconds per block on dry ground. Water and airborne penalties still apply. Other blocks and tools keep their normal speed.

tweaks.boatSteering.label: Boat steering
tweaks.boatSteering.description: Steer boats directly using movement keys. Speed and collision protection are separate.

tweaks.sneak.enabled.label: Fake sneak
tweaks.sneak.enabled.description: Prevent walking off ledges without crouching or slowing down.

tweaks.sneak.announceToggle.label: Fake sneak messages
tweaks.sneak.announceToggle.description: Show a chat message when fake sneak turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

logo.logo.lines.label: Title lettering
logo.logo.lines.description: Paint title tiles, choose their blocks and preview the lettering. Includes rotation, shadow, animation and saved presets.

power_controls:features.eatingSounds.label: Eating sounds
power_controls:features.eatingSounds.description: Play chewing when food is consumed.

power_controls:features.shearingSounds.label: Shearing sounds
power_controls:features.shearingSounds.description: Play a snip when a sheep is successfully sheared.

power_controls:features.toolBreakSounds.label: Tool break sounds
power_controls:features.toolBreakSounds.description: Play a sound when a tool reaches zero durability.

power_controls:features.armorBreakSounds.label: Armor break sounds
power_controls:features.armorBreakSounds.description: Play a sound when an armor piece breaks.

tweaks.boatSpeed.label: Faster boats
tweaks.boatSpeed.description: Raise the boat speed limit independently of steering.

tweaks.boatProtection.label: Boat collision protection
tweaks.boatProtection.description: Prevent boats from breaking when they hit blocks.

power_camera:config.doorCollision.label: Freecam door collisions
power_camera:config.doorCollision.description: With camera collisions enabled, also collide with doors and trapdoors. Off passes through them.

visual.containerCarry.label: Move containers
visual.containerCarry.description: Sneak and use an empty hand to carry a chest, furnace or dispenser. Target either half of a double chest to move only that half. Contents are journaled for recovery.

visual.inventoryInPortals.label: Inventory in portals
visual.inventoryInPortals.description: Open your inventory while standing in a Nether portal. Portal travel keeps its normal timing and closes the inventory before changing dimensions.

visual.shiftClickIntoCraftingGrid.label: Shift-click into crafting table
visual.shiftClickIntoCraftingGrid.description: Shift-click inventory stacks into the crafting-table grid in singleplayer. Fills matching stacks first, then empty slots. Returns leftovers to the source slot. Uses the normal transfer when the grid has no room.

power_compat:config.addBlockLightToDebug.label: Block light
power_compat:config.addBlockLightToDebug.description: Exact block-emitted light at your feet, from 0 to 15. Excludes sunlight and screen brightness.

visual.swapEquipment.label: Swap tools and armour
visual.swapEquipment.description: Click matching tools or armour with different durability to swap them. Singleplayer only; slot restrictions still apply.

tweaks.autoWalkHoldToWalk.label: Hold auto-walk key to walk
tweaks.autoWalkHoldToWalk.description: Tap to toggle walking. Hold beyond the threshold to stop walking when released.

visual.lowFire.label: Low fire
visual.lowFire.description: Lowers the on-screen flames when you are on fire, using the current texture pack's fire texture.

power_controls:userinterface.videoSettin.label: Original far-distance fog
power_controls:userinterface.videoSettin.description: Use Beta's original far-fog values at exactly 12 chunks. Other distances keep their normal fog.

logo.scrollingBackground.enabled.description: Scroll the classic tiled menu background. Does not affect panorama backgrounds.

logo.blocks.map.description: Choose a block for each character used in the title lettering.

power_mechanics:config.INTERACTIVE_BLOCK.label: Allow editing signs
power_mechanics:config.INTERACTIVE_BLOCK.description: Right-click an existing sign to edit it. Shift-right-click uses the held item instead.

tweaks.placement.announceToggle.label: Fast placement messages
tweaks.placement.announceToggle.description: Show a chat message when fast placement turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

tweaks.placement.announceRestrictionTogg.label: Placement restriction messages
tweaks.placement.announceRestrictionTogg.description: Show a chat message when the active placement restriction turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

tweaks.autoWalkAnnounceToggle.label: Auto-walk messages
tweaks.autoWalkAnnounceToggle.description: Show a chat message when auto-walk turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

tweaks.freeLookAnnounceToggle.label: Free look messages
tweaks.freeLookAnnounceToggle.description: Show a chat message when free look in Toggle mode turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

activeTweaks.cinematicCameraMessages.label: Cinematic camera messages
activeTweaks.cinematicCameraMessages.description: Show a chat message when cinematic camera turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

power_camera:config.playerMovementMessag.label: Player movement messages
power_camera:config.playerMovementMessag.description: Show a chat message when freecam player movement turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the Active tweaks HUD. Menu previews and world loading are silent.

visual.redstonePowerLevels.label: Redstone power levels
visual.redstonePowerLevels.description: Use clean redstone wire with a number showing its current power from 0 to 15. Changes appearance only.

audio.redstonePlacementSound.label: Redstone placement sound
audio.redstonePlacementSound.description: Play the stone placement sound when placing redstone dust. Uses the Blocks sound volume.

power_compat:config.addFacingToDebugOver.label: Facing direction
power_compat:config.addFacingToDebugOver.description: Include facing direction in the left-side F3 information.

interface.blinkingChatCursor.label: Blinking chat cursor
interface.blinkingChatCursor.description: Blink the chat cursor. Off keeps the beam visible while editing.

interface.debugTextColor.label: Text colour
interface.debugTextColor.description: Colour of all F3 debug text.

visual.damageCameraShake.label: Damage camera shake
visual.damageCameraShake.description: Tilt the camera when taking damage. Turning this off also disables fire damage shake.

visual.fireDamageCameraShake.label: Fire damage camera shake
visual.fireDamageCameraShake.description: Tilt the camera for burning and fire contact in singleplayer. Other damage, including lava and attacks while burning, keeps its normal shake. Requires Damage camera shake.

tweaks.autoMineAnnounceToggle.label: Auto-mine messages
tweaks.autoMineAnnounceToggle.description: Show a message when Auto-mine starts or stops during play.

activeTweaks.autoMine.label: Include Auto-mine
activeTweaks.autoMine.description: Show while Auto-mine is holding Attack / Break.

gameplay.mergeItems.label: Merge dropped items
gameplay.mergeItems.description: Combine nearby matching dropped items when enough are within the terrain render distance around the camera. Keeps normal stack limits, damage and item data. Singleplayer only.

gameplay.mergeThreshold.label: Item merging threshold
gameplay.mergeThreshold.description: Minimum dropped-item entities within terrain render distance before a merging sweep starts. Large sweeps continue across ticks. Idle checks run twice per second.

gameplay.limitTnt.label: Limit TNT work
gameplay.limitTnt.description: Spread TNT simulation and explosions across ticks, with fewer visible TNT entities and explosion particles. Chains take longer. Enable from the main menu before loading a struggling singleplayer world.

gameplay.tntPerTick.label: TNT explosions per tick
gameplay.tntPerTick.description: Maximum TNT detonations per tick while Limit TNT work is on. Waiting TNT retains its fuse and saves normally.

gameplay.tntMillis.label: TNT time budget
gameplay.tntMillis.description: Milliseconds of TNT work allowed per tick. Finishes the current TNT update before yielding, so one explosion can exceed this budget.

gameplay.leavesDropSaplingsInCreative.label: Leaves drop saplings in creative
gameplay.leavesDropSaplingsInCreative.description: Allow saplings from leaves decaying while you are in creative. Applies to normal and fast decay. Survival drops resume immediately when you leave creative.

visual.hideEntities.label: Hide selected entities
visual.hideEntities.description: Hide the selected entity types visually. Entities keep ticking and can still be hit or picked up. Use the toggle key to switch.

visual.hideItems.label: Include dropped items
visual.hideItems.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hideMobs.label: Include mobs
visual.hideMobs.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hidePlayers.label: Include players
visual.hidePlayers.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hideVehicles.label: Include boats and minecarts
visual.hideVehicles.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hideProjectiles.label: Include projectiles
visual.hideProjectiles.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hideTnt.label: Include primed TNT
visual.hideTnt.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.hideOther.label: Include other entities
visual.hideOther.description: Include this type when Hide selected entities is on. Changes rendering only.

visual.entityRenderingMessages.label: Entity visibility messages
visual.entityRenderingMessages.description: Show a chat message when the entity visibility hotkey changes state. Independent of the HUD.

visual.spectatorFullBright.label: Full bright in spectator
visual.spectatorFullBright.description: Automatically fully light the view on entering spectator. The full-bright hotkey can override it for that visit. Leaving spectator restores your earlier manual setting. Requires Allow Spectator mode in this world.

visual.fullBrightMessages.label: Full bright messages
visual.fullBrightMessages.description: Show a chat message when full bright turns on or off during gameplay. Independent of the HUD.

keys.power_beta.entities.label: Entity visibility (toggle)
keys.power_beta.entities.description: Toggle rendering for the selected entity types.

keys.power_beta.fullBright.label: Full bright (toggle)
keys.power_beta.fullBright.description: Fully light terrain and entities for rendering only. Leaves mob spawning and simulation light unchanged.

gameplay.flintIgnitesTnt.label: Flint and steel primes TNT
gameplay.flintIgnitesTnt.description: Right-click TNT with flint and steel to prime it. Uses one durability in survival; reusable in creative. Singleplayer only.

gameplay.fastItemCollisions.label: Fast item and TNT collisions
gameplay.fastItemCollisions.description: Skip redundant collision checks between dropped items and primed TNT. Keeps block and vehicle collisions, item pickup and explosion knockback. Singleplayer only.

tweaks.autoWalkCancelOnLostFocus.label: Cancel auto walk when game not focused
tweaks.autoWalkCancelOnLostFocus.description: Stop auto-walk when the game loses focus. Off preserves toggled walking. Pausing still pauses the world.

visual.limitCapeRotation.label: Limit cape rotation
visual.limitCapeRotation.description: Keep capes from flipping upward or twisting excessively during fast flight or vehicle travel. Changes rendering only.

gameplay.torchShovel.label: Torch shovel for sand/gravel
gameplay.torchShovel.description: Break sand and gravel with a torch at diamond-shovel speed when a diamond shovel is in your inventory. Uses one normal durability hit from the most worn diamond shovel. Singleplayer survival only.

keys.power_beta.clickMining.label: Temporary toggle click mining
keys.power_beta.clickMining.description: Temporarily invert Continuous click mining. Press again to restore the saved preference. Leaving the world clears the temporary state.

activeTweaks.clickMining.label: Include Temporary click mining
activeTweaks.clickMining.description: Show Click mining enabled or Click mining disabled while the temporary override is active.

veinMining.enabled.label: Vein mining
veinMining.enabled.description: Mine connected blocks after breaking one. Singleplayer survival only. Stops on tool changes, lost focus, menus or leaving the world.

veinMining.crouchingOnly.label: Crouching only
veinMining.crouchingOnly.description: Require crouching to start and continue vein mining. Off also allows normal mining.

veinMining.tools.label: Blocks and required tools
veinMining.tools.description: Choose blocks and the items allowed to mine each one. No required tools allows any item; normal harvesting requirements still apply. Redstone ore includes its lit state. Veins match the starting block metadata; containers are excluded.

veinMining.durabilityPerBlock.label: Durability per block
veinMining.durabilityPerBlock.description: Apply normal tool wear for every mined block. Off charges only the first block. Mining stops when the original tool breaks.

veinMining.maxBlocks.label: Maximum vein size
veinMining.maxBlocks.description: Maximum blocks mined per vein, including the first block.

veinMining.radius.label: Maximum search distance
veinMining.radius.description: Maximum distance from the first block along any axis. Touching corners and edges connect blocks; unloaded terrain is never searched.

veinMining.maxChecks.label: Maximum search checks
veinMining.maxChecks.description: Cap the total block positions examined per vein, including positions that do not match.

veinMining.checksPerTick.label: Search checks per tick
veinMining.checksPerTick.description: Maximum positions examined per tick. Searching also yields after one millisecond.

veinMining.blocksPerTick.label: Blocks mined per tick
veinMining.blocksPerTick.description: Maximum extra blocks mined per tick. Mining also yields after two milliseconds; an individual native block callback finishes normally.

veinMining.timePercent.label: Vein mining time
veinMining.timePercent.description: Time to break the first block, as a percentage of the time to mine the whole detected vein normally. At 25%, eight blocks take as long as two normal blocks. Searching finishes before mining progresses. Always takes at least one block's normal mining time.

power_camera:config.hideHudOnEntry.label: Hide HUD on entering freecam
power_camera:config.hideHudOnEntry.description: Hide the HUD when freecam starts. F1 can change it during freecam; leaving restores the entry state.

visual.removeUnderwaterOverlay.label: Remove underwater overlay
visual.removeUnderwaterOverlay.description: Hide the underwater texture overlay without changing water surfaces or fog. Full bright hides this overlay and uses normal distance fog while active, without changing this preference.

visual.underwaterFogDensity.label: Underwater fog density
visual.underwaterFogDensity.description: Underwater fog as a percentage of Beta's normal density. 100% is vanilla; 0% removes water fog while keeping normal lighting and terrain-distance fog. Full bright overrides this to 0% while active.

visual.underwaterDarkness.label: Underwater darkness
visual.underwaterDarkness.description: Water darkness while the camera is underwater. 100% keeps Beta lighting; 0% lets daylight through water while preserving night, roofs and other shadows. Fog and the water overlay are separate. Does not change actual light levels.

visual.underwaterDarknessOutside.label: Water darkness from outside
visual.underwaterDarknessOutside.description: Water darkness when the camera is outside water. 100% keeps Beta lighting; 0% lets daylight through water. Independent of underwater darkness and fog, with no change to actual light levels.

visual.narrowUnderwaterFov.label: Narrow field of view underwater
visual.narrowUnderwaterFov.description: Reduce field of view by 10 degrees while the camera is underwater, matching Beta. Disable to keep the same field of view above and below water. Applies in first and third person.

power_inventory:config.MODERN_MINECRAFT_.label: Shift-double-click transfer
power_inventory:config.MODERN_MINECRAFT_.description: Hold an item and Shift-double-click a matching stack to transfer matching items from that inventory. Leaves the held stack unchanged; multiplayer follows server support.

creative.spectatorGlide.label: Flight deceleration
creative.spectatorGlide.description: Coasting after releasing movement. 0 stops immediately; 5 matches modern Creative and Spectator deceleration. Lower values stop sooner without changing the configured speed. Applies horizontally and vertically.

creative.spectatorSprintToggle.label: Flight sprint activation
creative.spectatorSprintToggle.description: Hold requires the shared flight sprint key. Toggle keeps sprint active until movement stops on all axes.

creative.spectatorSprintMultiplier.label: Flight sprint speed
creative.spectatorSprintMultiplier.description: Multiplier of this mode's normal flight speed: 100% gives no boost; 200% doubles it. The flight speed setting applies first.

power_camera:config.sprintToggle.label: Freecam sprint activation
power_camera:config.sprintToggle.description: Hold requires the shared flight sprint key. Toggle keeps sprint active until movement stops on all axes.

power_camera:config.sprintMultiplier.label: Freecam sprint speed
power_camera:config.sprintMultiplier.description: Multiplier of this mode's normal flight speed: 100% gives no boost; 200% doubles it. The flight speed setting applies first.

logo.style.label: Title style
logo.style.description: Choose customisable retro block lettering or an original Beta, Java Edition or modern Minecraft logo. Your retro customisation is retained.

creative.acceleration.label: Flight acceleration
creative.acceleration.description: Response while starting, turning or changing flight speed. 0 reaches the target immediately; 5 matches modern Creative and Spectator acceleration. Lower values respond faster without changing the configured speed. Applies horizontally and vertically.

creative.spectatorAcceleration.label: Flight acceleration
creative.spectatorAcceleration.description: Response while starting, turning or changing flight speed. 0 reaches the target immediately; 5 matches modern Creative and Spectator acceleration. Lower values respond faster without changing the configured speed. Applies horizontally and vertically.

power_camera:config.acceleration.label: Freecam acceleration
power_camera:config.acceleration.description: Response while starting, turning or changing flight speed. 0 reaches the target immediately; 5 matches modern Creative and Spectator acceleration. Lower values respond faster without changing the configured speed. Applies horizontally and vertically. Default 3.5 gives a quicker response similar to earlier freecam movement.

gameplay.axesSlashLeaves.label: Axes slash leaves
gameplay.axesSlashLeaves.description: Break all leaf types faster with axes, scaled by tool material. Diamond takes about as long as a diamond shovel on sand. Keeps normal leaf drops and one normal durability hit per block. Singleplayer Survival only.

power_controls:userinterface.panoramaCon.label: Panorama only on the title screen
power_controls:userinterface.panoramaCon.description: Off also shows the selected panorama behind menus opened from the title screen. In-game menus keep their world background.

interface.hidePowerBetaVersion.label: Hide Power Beta version
interface.hidePowerBetaVersion.description: Hide the Power Beta version beside the Minecraft version on the title screen.

gameplay.boatPlacementFacing.label: Boat placement direction fix
gameplay.boatPlacementFacing.description: Place boats facing the direction you look, so forward starts in that direction when you board. Works with original and improved steering, at either speed. Affects new placements only. Singleplayer only.

gameplay.modernWaterMovement.label: Modern water movement
gameplay.modernWaterMovement.description: Gentler sinking and modern current response, especially in shallow or mixed currents. Hold Sneak to descend. Keeps normal swimming speed and Beta's upright player model and collision size. Players only, in singleplayer; flight and riding keep their own movement.

maps.minimap.label: Show minimap
maps.minimap.description: Show nearby explored terrain in the HUD. Appearance and position are edited in the HUD editor.

maps.worldMap.label: World map
maps.worldMap.description: Allow opening the explored world map with its binding.

maps.rotate.label: Rotate with camera
maps.rotate.description: Rotate the minimap so the current viewing direction points up.

maps.circular.label: Circular minimap
maps.circular.description: Clip the map to a circle instead of a square.

maps.hideWithDebug.label: Hide with F3
maps.hideWithDebug.description: Hide the minimap while debug information is visible.

maps.size.label: Minimap size
maps.size.description: Width and height in GUI pixels. Clamped to the available screen.

maps.corner.label: Minimap corner
maps.corner.description: Screen corner used by the minimap offsets.

maps.offsetX.label: Horizontal inset
maps.offsetX.description: GUI pixels inward from the selected screen edge.

maps.offsetY.label: Vertical inset
maps.offsetY.description: GUI pixels inward from the selected screen edge.

maps.opacity.label: Minimap opacity
maps.opacity.description: Opacity of minimap terrain and background.

maps.zoom.label: Minimap zoom
maps.zoom.description: GUI pixels per block. The zoom bindings also change this value.

maps.coordinates.label: Coordinates
maps.coordinates.description: Display the camera position beneath the minimap.

maps.biome.label: Biome name
maps.biome.description: Display the current biome beneath the minimap.

maps.clock.label: Time of day
maps.clock.description: Display the world's daylight clock beneath the minimap.

maps.compass.label: Compass letters
maps.compass.description: Show north, east, south and west around the minimap.

maps.colourMode.label: Terrain colours
maps.colourMode.description: Texture colours use block textures and biome tints. Map colours use native Beta map materials.

maps.caveMode.label: Cave mapping
maps.caveMode.description: Automatic maps the floor beneath a solid roof and in the Nether. Manual uses the selected ceiling.

maps.caveTop.label: Manual cave ceiling
maps.caveTop.description: Highest Y searched by manual cave maps. Cave data is separated into eight-block layers.

maps.roofSize.label: Automatic roof width
maps.roofSize.description: Width of the solid roof check around the camera. Larger checks avoid cave mode beneath a single tree.

maps.heightShading.label: Height shading
maps.heightShading.description: Shade terrain according to its elevation.

maps.slopeShading.label: Slope shading
maps.slopeShading.description: Shade changes in height to make slopes readable.

maps.caveLighting.label: Cave light shading
maps.caveLighting.description: Shade cave floors using their sampled native block light.

maps.radar.label: Entity radar
maps.radar.description: Show nearby entities already known to the client. Never loads terrain or requests entities.

maps.players.label: Players
maps.players.description: Show other loaded players as white markers.

maps.hostile.label: Hostile mobs
maps.hostile.description: Show loaded hostile mobs as red markers.

maps.animals.label: Animals
maps.animals.description: Show loaded animals and water creatures as yellow markers.

maps.items.label: Dropped items
maps.items.description: Show loaded dropped items as small red markers.

maps.otherEntities.label: Other entities
maps.otherEntities.description: Show other loaded entities as purple markers.

maps.entityNames.label: Entity names
maps.entityNames.description: Show names beside nearby radar markers.

maps.entityHeights.label: Height arrows
maps.entityHeights.description: Mark entities substantially above or below the camera.

maps.radarHeight.label: Vertical radar range
maps.radarHeight.description: Maximum height difference in blocks for radar markers.

maps.radarLimit.label: Entity checks per tick
maps.radarLimit.description: Bounded number of loaded entities considered each tick.

maps.waypoints.label: Map waypoints
maps.waypoints.description: Show enabled waypoints on both maps. Saved data remains when disabled.

maps.worldWaypoints.label: In-world waypoints
maps.worldWaypoints.description: Show waypoint labels and distances in the world view.

maps.waypointDistances.label: Waypoint distances
maps.waypointDistances.description: Show the horizontal distance to waypoint markers.

maps.waypointDistance.label: Waypoint range
maps.waypointDistance.description: Maximum marker distance. Zero is unlimited. Always show on a waypoint ignores this limit within its dimension and set.

maps.deathpoints.label: Death waypoints
maps.deathpoints.description: Record a waypoint at each local player's death, independently of death-item recovery.

maps.keepOldDeaths.label: Keep older deathpoints
maps.keepOldDeaths.description: Retain previous death waypoints when a new death is recorded.

maps.slimeChunks.label: Slime chunks
maps.slimeChunks.description: Highlight Beta slime chunks. Available only with a local world's actual seed.

maps.lightOverlay.label: Low-light shading
maps.lightOverlay.description: Highlight sampled block light below eight. Cave maps are most useful for this overlay.

maps.footsteps.label: Recent path
maps.footsteps.description: Show a bounded recent path for this visit. Dimension changes start a new path.

maps.pauseMap.label: Pause in map menus
maps.pauseMap.description: Pause singleplayer in the world map and waypoint menus. Multiplayer remains server-owned.

maps.columnsPerTick.label: Terrain columns per tick
maps.columnsPerTick.description: Maximum columns sampled per game tick, also limited by a short time budget. Reads loaded terrain only.

maps.cacheTiles.label: Cached map tiles
maps.cacheTiles.description: Maximum shared resident terrain tiles, including coarse zoom levels. Larger values use more memory.

maps.uploadsPerFrame.label: Texture uploads per frame
maps.uploadsPerFrame.description: Maximum map tiles uploaded to the GPU per rendered frame.

maps.refreshSeconds.label: Terrain revisit interval
maps.refreshSeconds.description: Seconds before revisiting a sampled chunk to detect edits. New chunks are sampled first.

sprint.enabled.label: Sprinting
sprint.enabled.description: Allow modern sprinting on foot in singleplayer. Disabled by default in every base. Uses native collision, surfaces and held-item behavior.

sprint.activation.label: Sprint activation
sprint.activation.description: Modern starts while the key is held and keeps sprinting until movement stops. Hold requires the key; Toggle uses press edges.

sprint.doubleTap.label: Double-tap forward
sprint.doubleTap.description: Start sprinting by pressing forward twice while grounded, as in modern Minecraft.

sprint.doubleTapTicks.label: Double-tap interval
sprint.doubleTapTicks.description: Maximum game ticks between forward presses. Modern Minecraft uses seven ticks.

sprint.jumpBoost.label: Sprint jump boost
sprint.jumpBoost.description: Add the modern 0.2-block horizontal impulse when jumping while sprinting.

sprint.particles.label: Sprint particles
sprint.particles.description: Kick up the native surface texture while sprinting on solid ground. Water and lava do not produce sprint dust.

sprint.sprintKnockback.label: Sprint attack knockback
sprint.sprintKnockback.description: Apply modern extra sprint-hit knockback and the attacker's movement slowdown after a successful hit.

sprint.speed.label: Sprint speed
sprint.speed.description: Movement speed relative to ordinary walking. Modern Minecraft uses 130 percent on the ground and in the air.

sprint.stamina.label: Use stamina
sprint.stamina.description: Drain stamina while sprinting. Exhaustion blocks another sprint until the restart threshold is recovered. Stored with the player.

sprint.noSprintInCombat.label: Block sprinting in combat
sprint.noSprintInCombat.description: Stop sprinting while the combat timer is active after dealing or receiving entity damage.

sprint.capacity.label: Stamina capacity
sprint.capacity.description: Maximum stamina held by the player.

sprint.drain.label: Stamina used per second
sprint.drain.description: Stamina drained each second while sprinting.

sprint.recharge.label: Stamina recovered per second
sprint.recharge.description: Stamina recovered per second after the recovery delay, while not sprinting.

sprint.rechargeDelay.label: Recovery delay
sprint.rechargeDelay.description: Seconds after sprinting stops before stamina can recover.

sprint.combatTime.label: Combat duration
sprint.combatTime.description: Seconds after the last successful entity hit before combat ends. Environmental damage does not start combat.

sprint.restartStamina.label: Restart threshold
sprint.restartStamina.description: Percentage of full stamina required to sprint again after exhaustion.

sprint.jumpCost.label: Sprint jump stamina cost
sprint.jumpCost.description: Additional stamina spent on a sprint jump. Zero keeps ordinary modern sprint-jump behavior.

sprint.rechargeInCombat.label: Recover stamina in combat
sprint.rechargeInCombat.description: Allow stamina recovery while the combat timer is active. Off by default.

sprint.dynamicFov.label: Dynamic sprint FOV
sprint.dynamicFov.description: Smoothly widen the world view while sprinting on foot, using modern speed-based FOV. Does not affect the held-item projection.

sprint.creativeFov.label: Dynamic Creative sprint FOV
sprint.creativeFov.description: Widen the view only while Creative flight is actually sprinting. Off by default.

sprint.spectatorFov.label: Dynamic Spectator sprint FOV
sprint.spectatorFov.description: Widen the view only while Spectator flight is actually sprinting. Off by default.

sprint.freecamFov.label: Dynamic freecam sprint FOV
sprint.freecamFov.description: Widen the detached camera view only while its flight is actually sprinting. Off by default.

sprint.fovStrength.label: Sprint FOV strength
sprint.fovStrength.description: Shared strength of enabled ground, Creative, Spectator and freecam sprint FOV effects. Zero keeps the normal field of view.
